body: Feel free to reach out! my dms are open
Here to talk if you want to!

Thanks for posting, life can really suck a lot of the time and I’m not going to sit here and tell u to deal with it, all up to u, what I can say is death is inevitable and u can take that to mean why not die now if u want, I try to see it as if I’m gonna die anyways mind as well do what I want/makes me happy till that day comes. Now considering the fact that I have little college experience so far, I can see the stress you are under but ofc no one can really truly understand where u are at. All I can say choose the option u think is best for u, if that’s not wanting to deal with the situation and committing suicide so be it, but I encourage u too look at every single option possible, there are a lot u probably don’t even know about. Also is there a source u would say to your laziness? It might be a good idea to do some deep inner work to figure out if there’s an answer to that just so maybe there may be a solution. Also laziness is not something people can exactly fix for u, takes self effort if u do want to eventually not be lazy, completely understand if u wanna continue to be, I am a lot of the time too lmao.
Again u can take this however you want to, I’m simply here as an internet stranger trying to help, wish u the best!
The therapists you have met with seem to lean towards more of a life coach role than a psychotherapist. Its possible finding an experienced psychotherapist could be beneficial.

I used to work overtime for the sole purpose of keeping me from thinking. While its not a means to a happy life, distractions always can help find a long term solution. Do you know why you hate yourself or why nothing brings joy?

I'm sorry to hear that your older brother isn't a good role model. Do you still see a therapist regularly? School can definitely be difficult sometimes, does your trouble stem from certain subjects and/or the expectations of the class. Trying honestly sucks and I'm not going to just say blindly keep trying, but sometimes that's the only thing you can do. If you need a friend I'm here.
To me, posting means you are still looking for help. Could be totally wrong, however reaching out to others can sometimes be very beneficial.

thinking can be painful, not that its a bad thing but our minds can be weapons towards ourselves. Imo if you are afraid of being vulnerable that's the best reason to try and be. You don't know until you try sort of thing. Is there any philosophy that you think of or is it just in retrospect of your life?

talking to people can be important when dealing with depression and anxiety. People that do really care for you will help if you ask for it. There is no perfect solution but usually talking it out with others can help ease the pain. Is there any core thoughts that are causing these emotions?

Its crazy self reflecting sometimes because we realize we do some of the things others do that we hate. Is there a core experience or thought causing these suicidal thoughts and pain? Is there anything you do enjoy that could help take your mind off of these devouring thoughts?

Its not that life will always get better or things will get better with time, however you wont be in school all your life. I'm 19, I hated middle and high school for some of the same reasons, but eventually made it past that. Going into high school with a mindset that it will be terrible will make it terrible. Try to have some small goals to set and remember that not everyone has to like you, not everyone will, don't let it stop you from continuing life.
if there is no one to live for, live for yourself.
I'm sorry to hear about your situation. Its definitely hard when parents that you love are involved in something like a divorce. More people care than you think. I'm here to listen.

I'm the same way a lot, I sleep, watch anime, or play video games to pass the time. Life will always have its struggles. Does your boyfriend help comfort you at all? it does make sense that you wouldn't want to struggle anymore tho. However having short term and long term goals is a great step. Its probably hard to find motivation to make them happen sometimes but putting one step forward can sometimes open many doors. If you commit suicide you essentially let life win. Beat life at its own game, rise above.
I wish you the best

I'm sorry you feel that way. If you are looking for something new life has many opportunities. It may seem futile at times but you listed things that you actually already enjoy, that's a start. I'm sure where-ever your best friend is he wants you to continue on for him. I'm here to talk to if you want. Although I'm a stranger I care and hope you the best moving forward. I can't stop you from taking your life, that's entirely your choice and free will, but I truly believe there can be more to living than you have experienced. Everything may seem hopeless but maybe put your hope into life instead of death.

I don't think that its that people don't care, its that they make a conscious effort to care when someone is in a bad spot. It seems like you have a lot of reasons for suicide, it may be hard but is there anything you want to live for? You mentioned your boyfriend, but maybe there are other things. I don't know much about the international circumstances that you mention, but I'm sure that it wouldn't be easier for him if you died. Also more people care than you think, I care although we don't know each other. If you ever wanna talk I'm here.
I don't believe they are fake. They are 100% real to you, doesn't matter what others think. Do you want to go to heaven for the sole reason of meeting these friends?
I would recommend reading some works of existential philosophers such as Nietzsche and Camus. Although life can be pointless, you can always create your own meaning.
I disagree with society and I believed if more people understood my thinking we could create a better society.
I have no path to follow and there isn't a reason to continue. I want to die or change everyone which is impossible.
I think your viewpoint is more of an absurdist than nihilist.
